reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in the thread in #north-random. I said I'd noted 15 August as the deadline for Thornbury Cloth Co.'s signed order form. I also pointed out that today is 14 October, so that date has already passed, and asked him to tell me if they meant next year or a different date.

I didn't take any other action, since he said none was needed. A deadline is an operational fact, not a money figure, so it was fine to mention it in the channel. I didn't look for his earlier post, and I don't have a separate place to save records beyond that thread.
